summary.text: Melissa Smith is the Democratic candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 39 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Kerri Seekins-Crowe.
A web developer and business owner, she also ran for the Montana House in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Melissa Smith was born in Des Moines, Iowa, earned a bachelor's degree from California State University, Northridge in 1996, and has worked as a web developer.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has had a long career as a business and project manager, owns a website and business systems development business, and has served on the boards of non-profit organizations focused on community service, child development and education.
Smith was the Democratic candidate for Montana House District 44 in 2022, when she lost to incumbent Larry Brewster, 35.5 percent to 64.5 percent.
In 2024 she was the Democratic candidate in District 39 and lost to Kerri Seekins-Crowe, 34.0 percent to 66.0 percent.
Her 2024 survey answers listed protecting personal freedom and the constitutional right to privacy, fair tax policy and affordable health care access as key campaign messages.
